stickit.config.title: Stick It!
stickit.config.max_stack_size.desc: Max stack size per slot (-1 or 0 to use default). Going above 64 needs a mod like StackUp!.
stickit.config.unplaceable_items.desc: Items that cannot be placed down, in the format "mod_id:item_id" e.g. "minecraft:carrot". You can also use the stickit:unplaceable item tag.
